design_philosophy.core_concept: Where traditional craftsmanship meets modern ethereal aesthetics. A fusion of soft pastels with sharp, editorial typography.
anti_patterns: No generic white backgrounds - use warm pearl/alabaster
No default 'primary blue' buttons - use brand rose/gold
No boxy grid layouts - use asymmetrical 'Tetris' grids
No pure black text - use deep charcoal or midnight blue

buttons.style: rounded-full px-8 py-6 text-sm uppercase tracking-widest font-semibold transition-all duration-300
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-[#1A1A1A] text-[#1A1A1A] hover:bg-[#1A1A1A] hover:text-white

inputs.style: rounded-none border-b border-gray-300 bg-transparent px-0 py-2 focus:border-[#E8A0BF] focus:ring-0 transition-colors

hero.alt: Elegant Indian Bride in Red and Gold

instructions_to_main_agent: 2. FONTS: Add the Google Fonts import to 'index.css' at the very top.
3. TAILWIND: Update 'tailwind.config.js' to include the custom colors (rose, serenity, charcoal) and font families.
4. LAYOUT: Do NOT use standard Bootstrap columns. Use the 'Tetris Grid' for the product showcase.
5. COMPONENTS: Customize Shadcn components. Remove default radii and use 'rounded-none' for cards but 'rounded-full' for buttons to create contrast.
6. IMAGES: Use the provided Unsplash/Pexels URLs. Do NOT use placeholders.
7. GLASSMORPHISM: Apply the 'glass' utility class to the sticky header and modal backgrounds.
universal_guidelines: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur)
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: 'transition: all'. This results in breaking transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations.
